title: Onboard promenade-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context: Add official support for promenade-13b v1.0 to the model registry. Promenade is a community release that matches our supported model contract (causal LM, fused attention kernels). This PR adds canonical metadata, a validated performance profile for our serving runtime, and wires in changelog/release-note automation so the model appears in release notes and the registry index automatically.

What I changed (high level):
- models/promenade/metadata.yaml: canonical metadata (model name, versions, tokenizer, architecture hints, recommended quantization profiles, pinned runtime kernels).
- perf/profiles/promenade-13b-v1.0.json: perf profile generated from lab benchmarks (latency/throughput for typical seq lengths and batch sizes).
- scripts/changelog/generate_release_notes.py: hook to convert registry entries into release notes; integrated into registry CI.
- docs/models/promenade.md: onboarding doc and quickstart.
- tests/perf/test_promenade_profile.py: validates profile shape and sanity checks against perf baselines.
- CI: added perf workflow to run an abbreviated benchmark on PRs that touch perf profiles.

Checklist:
- [x] Metadata follows registry schema and passes linting
- [x] Perf profile validated against lab benchmark harness and within expected variance
- [x] Changelog automation emits entry when profile metadata changes
- [x] Docs and quickstart added
- [x] Unit and perf tests added and passing

Motivation: Onboarding promenade-13b unlocks a new open-model option that has favorable cost/latency characteristics for customers targeting 8-16k context use-cases. Automating the changelog ensures product and release teams get consistent release notes without manual edits.

Notes: Perf profile was generated with the perf-lab harness (reference commit included). The profile includes recommended kernel bindings and a suggested quantization profile (int4/awq). We scoped full end-to-end integration tests to a separate follow-up to run larger TPU-size throughput tests (ENG-4902).
commits_summary: 9 commits: add metadata.yaml and model descriptor; generate perf profile from perf-lab; add perf sanity test; add changelog generation script and template; update docs and quickstart; CI perf workflow; fix linting; address reviewer comments.

Maya Chen: Docs: add a short troubleshooting note for tokenizer mismatches — small nit.
Author (Aisha Patel): Added troubleshooting section to docs/models/promenade.md.
release_notes:
- Onboard promenade-13b v1.0 to model registry.
- Add validated performance profile for Redwood serving runtime (recommended kernels and quantization profiles).
- Add automated changelog generation to surface registry changes in release notes.
risk_assessment: low: additions are additive to the registry and guarded by perf and unit tests; changelog automation only runs in CI and doesn't modify live docs without approval.
notes_for_release: Promenade is available in the model catalog after index refresh. Recommended default profile: promenade-13b-v1.0 (int4-awq) for balanced latency/cost. For high-throughput use-cases consider the quantized-8 profile listed in metadata.
follow_up: ENG-4902: run full throughput bench on on-prem hardware and validate autoscaling parameters for Dedicated clusters.
changelog_automation_test: verified: changelog entry generated by CI job 'registry-changelog' on a tagged commit; manual review approved the templated entry.
